ValidationRule.description: For Sales Offers, Corporate Scheme field has to be blank unless Sub Type = FOC Qantas Club Waiver.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( RecordTypeId = "01290000001UPUR", /*Sales Offers Request*/ NOT( ISPICKVAL ( Sub_Type__c , "FOC Qantas Club Waiver" )), NOT ( ISBLANK ( AssetId )) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You can only use the Corporate Scheme section for FOC Qantas Club Waiver
